extraction_notes: Transfer, output, and capacitance curves were digitized before using tabulated values. Digitized points are approximate reads from the plotted traces and preserve the published axes and curve test conditions.
The transfer curve retains the TJ = 25 degC trace from Fig. 2. The figure does not state VDS for the transfer plot.
Three representative output curves from Fig. 1 were retained at VGS = 3.0 V, 3.5 V, and 4.0 V. The figure does not state temperature or pulse conditions.
The capacitance-versus-voltage figure provides Ciss, Coss, and Crss traces from 0 V to 20 V at TJ = 25 degC and VGS = 0 V. The table values are specified at VDS = 20 V and f = 1 MHz.
The datasheet publishes no typical threshold-voltage table value; only the 1.0 V minimum and 2.3 V maximum are recorded.

The datasheet publishes total, threshold, gate-source, and gate-drain charge values, but no gate-charge curve was included in this extraction because the schema requires only the transfer, output, and capacitance curve families.
The datasheet publishes no body-diode reverse-recovery time or reverse-recovery charge.

Thermal data consists of junction-to-ambient resistance only: 300 degC/W steady state on a 1 sq in pad, 92 degC/W for t <= 5 s on a 1 sq in pad, 417 degC/W steady state on a minimum pad, and 154 degC/W for t <= 5 s on a minimum pad. No junction-to-case resistance is published.
omission_reason: No typical threshold value, body-diode reverse-recovery data, or junction-to-case thermal resistance is published. Transfer, output, and capacitance curve families are available and were digitized from the datasheet figures; the remaining omitted quantities are outside the required schema fields.
